page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m8s.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated, compute-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, the instance includes a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the middle tier for compute and memory operations. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a single-core Geekbench score of 1590.0 and a multi-core score of 12813.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 29573.87. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only large block bandwidth of 77.1 GB/sec and a write large block bandwidth of 51.61 GB/sec. For specialized workloads, the instance demonstrates a static web serving throughput of 20.48 GB/sec and executes 31.3 million Redis SET operations per second. LLM inference benchmarks for a small 135M model yield 1154.59 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 243.2 tokens/sec for text generation, while a medium 7B model achieves 32.25 tokens/sec and 12.06 tokens/sec respectively.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the fractional GPU allocation allows users to access hardware-accelerated graphics and compute capabilities without the expense of a full, dedicated GPU. This resource density makes the instance suitable for entry-level AI inference, virtual workstations, and moderate parallel computing tasks. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and lack of local storage indicate that workloads requiring massive memory footprints or high-speed local disk I/O are less optimal. Instead, the instance is best suited for lightweight machine learning inference, software compilation, 3D rendering, and web serving applications.
